description: The marker lines routing-bench's routing-compare prints today (swarm-routing/ns3-tools ns3/routing-bench, AntHocNet docs/benchmarks/metrics.md), plus the ##ARGS## and ##PROV## lines the dispatching workflow appends. Version 1 predates the ##HARNESS## version line (swarm-routing/ns3-tools#3): a v1 file may omit it; a later version requires it. Fields are only appended (ns3-tools golden rule 11); a removal or a change of meaning is a new version file here.

RUN.doc: ##RUN## <run> <arm> pdr delay delay99 thrput nrl [jitter off50 off90 nrl_bytes ...]: the per-seed row pairing uses

PROV.doc: provenance, written by the workflow, last line of the block; in this repo it must name the base digest, the campaign-image digest and every module commit of the manifest (spelled base=<ref>@sha256:.. image=<ref>@sha256:.. modules=<name>@<sha>,..)

ARGS.doc: the harness command line as dispatched

HARNESS.doc: ##HARNESS## version=<n>: the marker contract version (from version 2 on)
